headline: U.S. Crude Inventories Fall by 3.1 Million Barrels, EIA Says
summary: U.S. crude oil inventories decreased by 3.1 million barrels during the week ending October 16, according to Energy Information Administration data.
why: Weekly inventory changes reported by the EIA are closely watched indicators of domestic energy supply and demand balance, directly influencing global crude oil prices.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: A decrease in domestic crude oil inventories indicates tightening supplies, which typically pushes crude prices upward.
